name: House Majority PAC
summary: House Democrats' main super PAC, aligned with the party's House leadership (The Hill called it Pelosi-aligned in 2022) and the counterpart to the Republican Congressional Leadership Fund. It took in $294 million in the 2026 cycle by October, $183 million from 31 donors giving $1 million or more; its nonprofit arm House Majority Forward supplied $21.7 million.
